actual_literal_entries: The castle candle was still missing. But tonight, a song was waiting beneath Rumi’s pool.
I want to sing the first line. All by myself.
Then let’s make that your turn.
What if my voice wobbles?
It can wobble. It’s still yours. I’ll be beside you, if you want.
Is that a rainbow under the bench?
My detective hat!
Too low.
Now I can see.

actual_literal_entries: Under the pool lay a whole neighbourhood. Tonight, everyone would sing together.
The baker packed warm snacks. The tailor hung bright ribbons. Everyone had a song to bring.
Song Night! Bring your own voice! One last invitation for the bathhouse. Then I get a turn too!
The lanterns go up. The singing begins.
Stay beside me under the bridge. The tram stirs a strong current.
Our entrance will be HUGE!
That fan is hanging over my delivery path.
We’ll move it later. Come and clap!
But I need to get through now.
